They were founded in 1949 and currently play at [[Estádio Municipal Eng. Manuel Branco Teixeira]]. Their home kit is red-and-blue striped shirt with blue shorts and socks, and the away kit is all white. Their current president is Bruno Carvalho and their manager is [[Moreno (Portuguese footballer)|Moreno]]. Chaves have competed in the [[Primeira Liga|Portuguese First Division]] 18 times and had their best finish of fifth-place in the 1989–90 season. They went to Europe in the 1987–88 season, where they played in the [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]], beating Romanian side [[CS Universitatea Craiova|Universitatea Craiova]] in the first round and losing to Hungarian team [[Budapest Honvéd FC|Budapest Honvéd]] in the next round."}}
